_verification_procedure.doi: Check each PDF header/footer or search CrossRef (api.crossref.org/works?query=<title>). Do not infer from filename.
_verification_procedure.mrq_2025_included: Open doi:10.1007/s11301-025-00554-0. Find the list/table of included studies (Appendix or Table listing 61 studies). Match by DOI or exact title. Being in the reference list is NOT sufficient.
_verification_procedure.publication_version: Check PDF for journal header, page numbers, copyright notice, or repository stamp. Warwick WRAP and similar repositories often serve accepted manuscripts.
